name: mister-handy
description: Mister Handy: the main session is HQ by default. A SessionStart hook marks HQ vs worker; HQ sends every substantive task out as a written brief to Orca worktrees, or to background subagents in git worktrees without Orca. Workers report through a STATUS file, never into HQ; status, follow-ups and cleanup without pulling transcripts back in.
